北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴冷，体感 -13℃。请注意保暖，多喝热水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is clear but feels like -13℃. Stay warm and hydrated!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴冷，体感 -6℃，风力不小。记得多添衣防风！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and chilly, feels like -6℃ with wind. Dress warmly and stay protected!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴冷，体感 -3℃。寒意渐浓，外出记得多穿点！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and feels like -3℃. It's getting cold, dress warmer when out!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，体感 5℃。虽然不算太冷，也别着凉哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and feels like 5℃. Don't catch a cold!
广州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感 9℃。气温回升，早晚温差大，注意哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is partly cloudy, feels like 9℃. Mind the temperature difference!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴冷，体感 -6℃。寒风阵阵，出门要穿暖和点！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and feels like -6℃. Wear warm clothes when going out!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴冷，体感 -8℃。寒气逼人，多穿衣裤，注意防寒！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and feels like -8℃. Stay warm and protect yourself from cold!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 1℃。微凉，多喝温水，保持好心情！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and feels like 1℃. Stay warm and keep a good mood!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴冷，体感 -6℃。气温较低，记得及时添衣保暖！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and feels like -6℃. The temperature is low, dress warmly!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴好，体感 -3℃。虽有阳光，但依旧寒冷，注意保暖！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is clear but feels like -3℃. Even with sun, it's cold. Stay warm!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 2℃。湿冷，注意保暖，小心着凉哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and feels like 2℃. It's damp and cold, stay warm!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨极寒，体感 -28℃。外出务必裹严实，千万别冻着！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold, feels like -28℃. Bundle up tightly when going out!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -28℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴冷，体感 -28℃。超低温，请做好极致保暖措施！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is clear and feels like -28℃. Extreme cold, take utmost care to stay warm!
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -28℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴暖，体感 7℃。紫外线强，出行别忘防晒哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is clear and feels like 7℃. Strong UV, don't forget sun protection!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴冷，体感 6℃，风力不小。出门添衣，小心感冒！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and feels like 6℃ with wind. Dress warmly and watch out for colds!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 -15℃，风力大。防风保暖是关键，别冻伤！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and feels like -15℃ with strong wind. Stay warm and wind-protected!
青岛.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -15℃ | 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 -17℃。寒风凛冽，注意防寒，多加衣！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and feels like -17℃. It's very cold, dress warmly!
大连.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -17℃
